title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go. Experience with data structures and algorithms.
description: Join Google for a 12 to 14-week summer internship working on real-world software infrastructure and customer-facing products alongside Google engineers.

title: Chevening Fully Funded UK Government Scholarship
eligibility: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country with at least 2 years of work experience.
qualification: Undergraduate degree qualifying for entry to a postgraduate program at a UK university.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from around the world to pursue a one-year master's degree in any subject at any UK university.

title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
eligibility: Open to candidates globally with strong communication and technical troubleshooting abilities.
qualification: Experience with Linux systems, Git, basic web application stacks, and REST APIs.
description: Help users and enterprise clients solve complex technical challenges with GitLab CI/CD, deployment platforms, and developer workflows in a 100% remote company.

title: Junior Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or early career professionals with 0-2 years of relevant experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or Math. Hands-on experience with SQL and PowerBI.
description: Transform data into meaningful product insights, support strategic decision-making, and build automated reporting pipelines across Cloud & AI divisions.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Developer Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in accredited high school, college, or university worldwide.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD + Mentorship from Satya Nadella
qualification: Background in software development, artificial intelligence, or cloud solutions using Azure.
description: Compete with global student developer teams to build cutting-edge solutions addressing social and environmental issues using Microsoft AI and cloud services.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and learners worldwide with no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level computer science course teaching students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
